scope: Branch tip: ObfuscationOS debug lane with native boot, and release build against the release SDK whose rescue applications are the never-opened stand-ins.
claims: ObfuscationOS boots native userland on x86_64, arm32 and ppc against the debug SDK
ObfuscationOS kernel-sdk-check and distro image (incl. system-gui) link against the release SDK

sources.relation: blob-identical to the commit (every tracked file)

sources.why_not_read: docs/BUILD.md, docs/PLAN.md and src/rescue/README.md: documentation no command here reads

environment.xmake: xmake v3.1.1+HEAD.3ba37a0, A cross-platform build utility based on Lua
environment.systoolchain: SysToolchain 0.1.0 release archives (one per triple), installed with --systoolchain_dir

commands.label: ObfuscationOS debug lane x86_64
commands.command: cd <kernel tree> && xmake f -c -y -m debug -a x86_64 --systoolchain_dir=<systoolchain>/x86_64-elf --qemu_binary=<...>/qemu-system-x86_64 && xmake -y -j 6 -b kernel-sdk && cd <ObfuscationOS@658b18b> && xmake f -c -y -m debug -a x86_64 --kernel_sdk=<kernel tree>/build/sdk/x86_64/debug --systoolchain_dir=<systoolchain>/x86_64-elf && xmake -b kernel-sdk-check && xmake -b distro_image && xmake -b rootfs-simplefs && xmake qemu-distro --fs=simplefs --require-native --timeout=120

commands.command: cd <kernel tree> && xmake f -c -y -m debug -a arm32 --systoolchain_dir=<systoolchain>/arm-none-eabi --qemu_binary=<...>/qemu-system-arm && xmake -y -j 6 -b kernel-sdk && cd <ObfuscationOS@658b18b> && xmake f -c -y -m debug -a arm32 --kernel_sdk=<kernel tree>/build/sdk/arm32/debug --systoolchain_dir=<systoolchain>/arm-none-eabi && xmake -b kernel-sdk-check && xmake -b distro_image && xmake -b rootfs-simplefs && xmake qemu-distro --fs=simplefs --require-native --timeout=120
